items.title: MECH-180 ecological end-to-end: SD-MEL-PRODUCER novelty (world_rule_shift, VALIDATED) -> measured waking MEL -> SWS-write / spindle-density / hippocampal-replay-rate dose-response via the live SD-MEL-CONSUMER SleepLoopManager path
items.note: GOVERNANCE-FLAGGED evidence run (cycle great-hopper-1d7b24, 2026-07-30/31; chip chip-20260731-mech180-ecological-run). Tests MECH-180 ecologically end-to-end for the FIRST time: SD-MEL-PRODUCER (VALIDATED V3-EXQ-798a, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-798a_2026-07-30 -- world_rule_shift produces graded, above-reference, genuinely learnable waking MEL, cleanly separated from a matched noise control) drives real ecological novelty; SD-MEL-CONSUMER (BUILT+PROVEN via V3-EXQ-718a injection PC) converts measured MEL into offline-consolidation duration via the live SleepLoopManager/force_cycle path. No prior run combines the two: 798a runs with the consumer ABSENT by design; 718a's sleep-bearing ecological arms used the broken env_drift knob, not world_rule_shift. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: 3 counted substrate_ceiling autopsies for MECH-180 (677, 718, 718a; script-verified count via the Step 2.5b brake script, threshold >=2) but RELEASED -- the named upstream substrate SD-MEL-PRODUCER is now IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; docs/architecture/sd_mel_producer.md Status: VALIDATED), so this is the correct next test of a now-built substrate, not a same-ceiling re-derive. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (SWS/replay DVs monotone in ecologically-measured MEL when driven by world_rule_shift through the live sleep loop) is not recorded in any existing manifest on a compatible substrate_hash -- not recoverable by reanalysis, fresh run required. V3 PROXY MAPPING (honest operationalization, see script docstring): "slow-wave activity power" -> sws_n_writes (established 677/718/718a DV); "hippocampal replay rate" -> rem_n_rollouts (established DV, literally hippocampal.replay/diverse_replay call count during REM); "sleep spindle density" -> sws_slot_diversity (mean pairwise cosine distance of ContextMemory slots after the SWS pass -- a genuinely distinct geometric/differentiation statistic from the write count, already computed by run_sws_schema_pass at zero extra cost; does NOT reuse MECH-122's separate Phase-3 ThetaBuffer spindle-coordination mechanism, which would misattribute that claim's evidence to MECH-180). DESIGN: 5 arms (4 ecological ON, world_rule_shift interval {0,60,25,10}/depth 2 -- 798a's exact validated ladder -- + 1 matched-novelty consumer-OFF control) x 3 seeds. READINESS: R1 world-model trained (frozen-probe conv_rel_drop) AND R2 measured-MEL gradient survives in THIS run's full agent config (re-confirms 798a's link under z_goal/benefit machinery + live sleep loop, absent from 798a's diagnostic setup); below-floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a MECH-180 verdict. C1 (LOAD-BEARING, conjunctive): each of the three DVs monotone in MEASURED per-arm mean MEL across the 4 ON arms, on >=2/3 seeds -- MECH-180 predicts all three increase together, so partial support is recorded distinctly (mel_producer_consumer_partial_dv_support / mixed), not folded into a blanket pass/fail. C2 (control): OFF arm's step-bounded counts pinned (near-zero variance; slot_diversity reported but not gated, since it is an emergent geometric quantity, not a directly parameter-bounded count) AND ON-HIGH exceeds OFF-HIGH on all three DVs. DV-SYMMETRY: shift-rate -> measured MEL -> mel_consumer.duration_factor() -> REAL sws_consolidation_steps/rem_attribution_steps config values consumed by run_sws_schema_pass/run_rem_attribution_pass; none of the three DVs is invariant under a broadcast/monotone-rescale/permutation symmetry of the manipulation. z_goal_enabled=True is inherited (config parity with 718a/798a) but inert/arm-symmetric -- DEAD_Z_GOAL_STREAM_EXEMPT declared, wiring it would confound the MEL/DV comparison via the SD-024 benefit producer. MINT: in-run self-mint ON (arm_cell reuse-eligible fingerprints). SEPARATE baseline mint SKIPPED (neither disqualifier applies cleanly and no known parallel consumer is planned yet). SLEEP DRIVER: manual-cycle-loop (force_cycle once per cycle). Smoke --dry-run PASS (3-arm subset NONE_ON/HIGH_ON/HIGH_OFF: no crash, manifest+sentinel written, dry-run-relocated with no evidence/ leak; validate_experiments --strict 0 findings incl. arm_fingerprint; validate_recording --strict OK, 0 always-core gaps; progress instrumentation correct, ep N/75 x2 boundary prints + 3 verdict lines). ID NOTE: originally drafted as V3-EXQ-844 but renamed to 845 after discovering a concurrent session had independently claimed 844 for an unrelated MECH-321 chip in the same shared checkout (~80s earlier); no file/queue overlap resulted.

items.title: MECH-321 R4 mid-execution: does the abort hook improve task/harm outcome?

NOT a repeat of the 2026-07-29-refused 816e env-harshening re-queue -- that refusal targets the PRE-COMMIT/R1 forward-PE discrimination-floor axis (816/816b/816c/816d); this is R4 (mid-execution), reached via 839's clean (non-verdict-free) reachability result, per the 2026-07-30 governance note's explicit routing. Reuses the sd084_midexec_reachability baseline module verbatim (env/schedule/both seed tiers, ARM_HANDLE_OFF/ARM_HANDLE_ON) -- the only manipulation is unchanged; only the instrumentation (per-tick forward-PE + harm) and DV differ. GOV-REUSE-1: 839's own behavioural_delta is a WHOLE-RUN aggregate (mixed/near-null: seed 3/71/89 harm delta -0.0007/-0.0020/-0.0004) and retains no per-tick forward-PE or raw harm sequence, so the decisive windowed (post-divergence-tick) statistic this run needs is not recoverable via reanalysis -- fresh run required; OFF arm reuse attempted via try_reuse_cell citing 839's mint and correctly refused (needed_keys not in 839's schema), falls through to a fresh run, re-minted reuse-eligible for a future consumer. Seed tiers RE-MEASURED fresh (not imported from 839): ON-decomposes seeds (this run's own decomp_n_decomposed_midexec > 0) carry the load-bearing C1; fires-but-inert / negative-control seeds (839's seed 47 pattern) are a non-gating null check. Effect-size gate mirrors V3-EXQ-816's P1-P3/EFFECT_SIZE_K_SIGMA shape; n is small (<=3 seeds ever decompose) by SUBSTRATE CONSTRUCTION (no chunk-selection-bias knob), not under-design -- self-routes midexec_task_effect_underpowered rather than a forced verdict if so. Smoke PASS (validate_experiments --strict 0 findings incl. arm_fingerprint; validate_recording --strict OK, 0 always-core gaps).

items.title: ARC-005 GAP-B: per-channel leave-one-out ablation on mode-occupancy authority (re-scoped, occupancy-only)
items.note: GAP-B in the two-node ARC-005 validation ladder (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_005_control_plane_routing_plan.md, node arc_005_control_plane_routing:GAP-B, re-scoped 2026-07-31 per chip chip-20260731-arc005-802-reconcile). GAP-A (V3-EXQ-802, landed 2026-07-22, reviewed by governance 2026-07-25) established the control plane has causal authority over mode occupancy AS A WHOLE (C1 PASS, d_channel_mean=1.0 vs d_content_mean=0.0) but showed literally ZERO measured response of log10_precision_mean to any of the four channels (bit-identical across L0/L1/L2 for every content x seed pair) -- so C2 monotonicity failed by construction, and per-channel attribution was explicitly declared UNTESTED (802's own channel_attribution_limit). This run answers WHICH channel(s) carry the occupancy authority. RE-SCOPED to occupancy ONLY (not precision, per the plan doc's mandatory_design_check): a leave-one-out contrast on log10_precision_mean would measure a difference of two constant (non-responsive) terms -- an arithmetic identity, not a measurement, for all four channels in this harness (802 confirmed this empirically, not merely anticipated). Precision is still recorded (generous-recording convention) but scored nowhere; see manifest custom_information.precision_out_of_scope. DESIGN: 6 arms x 5 seeds, content set A only (802 already showed content has ~zero occupancy effect, d_content_mean=0.0, so a single content set suffices for channel attribution) -- ARM_ALL_ON (all 4 channels at L2, byte-identical to 802's L2_A), 4 leave-one-out arms (ARM_<channel>_OFF: exactly one of {5HT, PHASIC, MODEPRIOR, PCC} returned to L0 while the other three stay at L2), ARM_ALL_OFF (all 4 at L0, byte-identical to 802's L0_A). SCORE: per-channel authority_X(seed) = TV(occ(ALL_ON),occ(ALL_OFF)) - TV(occ(X_OFF),occ(ALL_OFF)) -- the drop in the channel-vs-baseline occupancy effect attributable to channel X in isolation. C1_X (load-bearing, one per channel): mean_s authority_X >= 0.8*SD_s(authority_X) AND >= 0.15 (same gate shape as 802's own C1). PASS iff >=1 channel individually clears the gate (evidence_direction supports, whether or not the contributing set matches the plan doc's readiness-probe EXPECTATION that channels 3/mode-prior and 4/pcc-threshold-leg carry most of the authority -- an unexpected 5HT/PHASIC contribution still supports ARC-005, just more distributed than predicted; expectation_match records the comparison). FAIL iff no channel individually clears the gate -> evidence_direction mixed (802's own joint result stands; only the decomposition is uninformative, not a refutation). DV-SYMMETRY (mandatory, all 5 non-baseline arms, full declaration in script docstring): every leave-one-out arm retains at least one non-argmax-invariant channel (channel 3's per-mode logit shift in 4 of 5 arms; channel 1's dACC reshape + channel 4's MECH-259 threshold leg in ARM_MODEPRIOR_OFF), so none is a provable identity. ARM_PHASIC_OFF is the specific risk the plan doc's mandatory_design_check names (channel 2 is a pure E3 softmax temperature with no direct SalienceCoordinator entry point) -- resolved by confirming E3's live selection path samples via torch.multinomial (not deterministic argmax; CLAUDE.md cross-machine-class note + ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py), so a temperature change genuinely alters the realised trajectory and downstream dACC/AIC context: real but indirect, not an identity. ARM_PCC_OFF ablates the WHOLE pcc_stability_baseline scalar (both the argmax-invariant MECH-048 mu leg AND the non-invariant MECH-259 threshold leg share one config value in this substrate), so it is NOT the narrower 'channel-4-mu-only' identity risk the mandatory_design_check flags -- that would need a leg-split design this substrate does not expose (noted as leg_split_untested, out of scope). SUBSTRATE_NOTES: all four carried over verbatim from 802 (use_dacc+use_aic_analog required or the mode can never switch; phasic_burst_signal_source=instantaneous_pe+carry required or channel 2 is inert; 5-HT pinned at channel OUTPUT via gain_min==gain_max; non-degeneracy gates on the DESIGN-level n_distinct_argmax_modes_across_design>=2, never per-arm). REUSE: ARM_ALL_ON and ARM_ALL_OFF are byte-identical in construction to 802's L2_A/L0_A cells (asserted at startup) and both attempted via try_reuse_cell citing reuse_baseline_from=v3_exq_802_arc005_control_plane_routing_double_dissociation_20260722T212125Z_v3, include_driver_script_in_hash=False -- an extension beyond the plan doc's minimum ask of reusing only ARM_ALL_OFF, since the same mechanism/justification applies to both cells. Smoke-confirmed REFUSED (fingerprint_not_in_index, all 4 attempted cells) because 19 commits touched ree_core/** between 802 landing (2026-07-22) and this authoring (2026-07-31), busting the default whole-tree substrate_hash even though none confirmed to touch the four channel modules -- expected, safe fallback to a fresh run of all 30 cells; not a bug. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (per-channel occupancy-authority drop) recorded in zero manifests -- 802 explicitly declares per-channel attribution untested; not recoverable except via the two whole-arm reuse attempts above. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): 0 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsies against ARC-005 (script-verified) -- brake does not apply. MINT: fresh leave-one-out cells fingerprinted with include_driver_script_in_hash=False (same lineage exq802_arc005_control_plane), cross-driver reusable by a future sibling. Smoke --dry-run PASS (2 seeds x 6 arms = 12 cells, no crash; reuse correctly attempted+refused with a legible reason; all 6 arms green on the dry tick-floor; criteria/label/expectation_match computed sensibly -- smoke run showed MODEPRIOR carrying the full effect and 5HT/PHASIC/PCC at zero, matching the readiness-probe expectation, though this is a 2-seed/40-tick smoke and not a real result; validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings incl. arm_fingerprint; validate_recording.py --strict OK, 0 always-core gaps; progress instrumentation correct, ep N/2000 x6-arm boundary prints + up to 30 verdict lines). CLAIM CONTENTION NOTE: ree-v3/experiment_queue.json carried two other active TASK_CLAIMS sessions (mech180-ecological-run, chip-mech321-r4-successor) at claim-open time -- opened with --allow-overlap since this is an unrelated claim (ARC-005 vs MECH-180/MECH-321) on a shared coordination file, no content overlap. ID NOTE: originally planned as V3-EXQ-845 but 845 was claimed by a concurrent session (MECH-180) between task-claim-open and script-write time; re-verified 846 free immediately before this queue append (Step 5 protocol).

items.title: MECH-294 behavioural falsifier re-run (measurement-window fix): contaminated_harm=0.0 closes self-contamination confound that starved V3-EXQ-840
items.note: Corrects V3-EXQ-840, which FAILed its readiness gate on all 3 packet-ON arms via adequate_committed_window_sample (worst-cell n_p1_ticks_past_window: JOINT=27, ALT=6, SHUF=92 vs floor=200). A prior failure_autopsy mischaracterised the cause as sub-floor joint_route_range_supra_floor (coherence routing) -- WRONG per direct manifest read (measured 0.063841 vs floor 0.01, ~6.4x headroom; recorded as diagnosis_correction on substrate_queue.json sd_id mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening, corrected_by_session confident-morse-af47a8). Per-cell data shows the SAME seeds (45, 49) starved EVERY arm including ARM_0_OFF (packet off entirely), ruling out packet-ON coherence routing as cause. Root physical cause: ENV_KWARGS declared a HARM-FREE env (num_hazards=0, hazard_harm=0.0, proximity_harm_scale=0.0) but left contaminated_harm at its 0.4 default -- self-contamination (agent revisiting its own trail) is not gated by num_hazards and drained agent_health for those seeds, triggering early episode termination well before the 200-step episode budget. FIX: contaminated_harm=0.0 closes the last health-depletion route (causal_grid_world.py's step() only ends an episode from agent_health<=0 or steps>=500; with hazard cells absent and all harm scales zeroed, that can never fire within a 200-step episode), so every cell now deterministically gets the full NOMINAL_WINDOW_TICKS=3600, ~18x the floor, for every seed. Applied identically across all 4 arms (env-level parameter, not routed through binding mode) so it cannot bias C1/C2; does NOT touch compose_per_candidate_coherence or the route-range readiness floor (both confirmed working correctly by the diagnosis). Preferred over inflating STEPS_PER_EPISODE/P1_MEASUREMENT_EPISODES: that adds compute without removing the confound and stays probabilistic rather than deterministic. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (committed-action-class TV across joint/alt/shuffled with per-candidate coherence routed) checked against V3-EXQ-840 itself -- NOT recoverable (that run self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue on an inadequate sample) -- run. Smoke 2026-07-31: all 4 arms build+route+PASS at dry-run scale, no crash; validate_experiments.py --strict clean. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b) reviewed: validate_queue flags a WARN citing 2 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory MECH-294 autopsies (failure_autopsy_569f-661-654a_2026-06-10, about the pre-2026-06-19 SCALAR-coherence defect since fixed by the per-candidate amend; failure_autopsy_batch-687a-707c-840-748a-833-842-810b-673-614-798afail_2026-07-30, whose own recommended_epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect -- it counted only because its recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=create had not yet been corrected). EXEMPT: this is not a same-granularity re-test of a substrate ceiling -- the diagnosis_correction on substrate_queue.json sd_id mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening already established the named upstream substrate is diagnosis_corrected_no_substrate_defect (no build owed; route-range readiness independently confirmed MET at 6.4x floor). This queue entry repairs the EXPERIMENT measurement instrument, not the substrate. Follow-on chipped: correct the stale autopsy artifact action field to none/repair so the brake counter reflects this going forward.

items.title: MECH-476 DOSE-axis consolidation falsifier REDESIGN: noise-scaled margin + n=10 (supersedes 836)
items.note: Redesign of V3-EXQ-836 per failure_autopsy_mech476-mech475-cluster_2026-07-29.md: 836's non_monotone_dose_response verdict rested on a FIXED 0.15 margin not scaled to observed per-arm noise (dose_bc300 SEM=0.150 at n=6, comparable to the between-arm deltas the verdict was read from) and did not survive a leave-one-out check (one seed at retained_fraction=1.274 drove the dose_bc300 mean). Fix (both applied): (1) RESISTANCE_DOSE_MARGIN replaced with a noise-scaled floor max(EFFECT_SIZE_K=1.5 * sd_delta, EFFECT_SIZE_ABS_FLOOR=0.05), sd_delta = SD of the per-seed paired (max_dose-min_dose) retained_fraction delta, mirroring v3_exq_824a's EFFECT_SIZE_K/ABS_FLOOR convention; (2) seeds 6->10 per arm; (3) median reported alongside mean per arm; (4) in-line leave-one-out robustness diagnostic on the load-bearing delta. User-confirmed routing via AskUserQuestion 2026-07-29 ("Redesign re-run (noise-scaled margin + more seeds)"). hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json qid=competence_floor hid=H-mech476-dose-response left alive (836 uninformative, not falsifying) and names this queue_id in its own basis text. GOV-REUSE-1: the noise-scaled dose-response verdict is not recorded in any prior manifest (836's own manifest computed it under the wrong rule and at n=6) -> must run. Re-derive brake: does not apply -- 836's epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect (not substrate_ceiling) with recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none. FLAG for V3-EXQ-836b's own eventual autopsy: 836b (still running as of this queueing, INTERVAL arm) uses the identical fixed RESISTANCE_INTERVAL_MARGIN=0.15 literal pattern (verified by direct grep of the script) -- same discrimination-rule defect is very likely present there too; check before trusting any SUPPORTED/WEAKENED/NON-MONOTONE verdict from it. 836b is out of scope for this redesign chip and was not modified. Smoke PASS (validate_experiments.py --strict: 2 OK / 0 warnings; --dry-run runs end-to-end, correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue on the tiny dry-run doses, no crash).

items.title: MECH-324 rapid-reacquisition falsifier RE-RUN: reacquisition-window isolation fix (supersedes 829)
items.note: Validation for IGW-20260731-196 (/implement-substrate MECH-324/MECH-323 reacquisition-window isolation fix; design doc REE_assembly/docs/architecture/mech324_reacquisition_window_isolation.md). V3-EXQ-829 (ree-v3 77e3ddc) FALSIFIED rapid reacquisition: median_r_reacq flat at 90 (W=100) / 28 (W=30) across every tested f_reacq, r_reacq/window_trials = 0.908 +/- 0.029 -- the revival gate's variance/mean readout came from the accumulator's whole-lifetime tally, saturated at dissolution with the contaminating stream, so clearing the variance gate tracked window_trials, not the reacquisition_repetition_factor bar. FIX: new sub-switch use_reacquisition_window_isolation (default False, nested under use_chunk_dissolution_retention) routes the revival gate through a dedicated per-chunk window (ChunkedPrimitive.reacquisition_outcomes) populated only from real post-dissolution executions. This run adds the flag as a THIRD ablation axis (ISOON/ISOOFF) crossed with 829's EXACT f_reacq sweep {1.0,0.5,0.25,0.1} and window_trials {30,100} -- the ISOOFF arms are the direct apples-to-apples reproduction of 829's own measurement (in-run negative control, not a separate claim), the ISOON arms are the corrected substrate under test. Same seeds as 829 (11,23,37,43,59,71) for direct comparability. Load-bearing C1/C2/C3 now read the ISOON default arm (unchanged thresholds: SCALING_RHO_FLOOR=0.8, R_MIN=20); C4 (ISOON short-window), C5 (paired ISOON-vs-ISOOFF direct comparison), C6 (ISOOFF reproduces 829's flat signature) are reported, non-gating. Dropped 829's MILD-dissolution arm (C5 there) to bound this run's grid to 18 arms x 6 seeds = 108 cells -- orthogonal to the isolation question and already confirmed non-artifactual by 829 itself; a successor may re-add it if an isolation x dissolution-stream interaction becomes a live question. GOV-REUSE-1: 829's cells fingerprinted with the DEFAULT include_driver_script_in_hash=True (829's own docstring: deliberate refuse-by-default), so a different driver can never match regardless of config -- checked before authoring, not recoverable via try_reuse_cell, fresh run required. This run fingerprints the same way (pure-python operator cells, no reuse value). Precondition/readiness-gate machinery, DV-symmetry class, and OUTCOME_SPAN pre-registration are unchanged from 829 (isolation changes which window the two existing MECH-323 gates read, not the gates themselves or the driver's harness). Smoke --dry-run PASS (1 seed x 18 arms, all preconditions green, C1-C6 all True at n=1, rho_ISOON=1.0 exact, rho_ISOOFF=n/a correctly reproducing the flat/undefined-rank signature; validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings incl. arm_fingerprint; progress instrumentation correct, ep N/1050 boundary prints + 18 verdict lines at n=1 -> 108 expected at n=6).
